about: Draws a row of controls over a table or a list, folding what matters least on a narrow row.

radius.about: Every corner of an outlined row.
radius.title: Corners

room.about: One row in three widths. A row folds on its own width rather than the window's, so the way to read the fold is to change the room and leave the row alone: the search gives up the end of the row, then the controls behind the separator give up their words, and what is left goes under the folded control.
room.title: Rooms

size.about: Every size. The size moves the gaps, the separator and the controls together, so a row at one step and controls at another never happens.
size.title: Sizes

title: Toolbar

variant.about: Every look. The row is one stop in the tab order and the arrows move along it.
variant.title: Looks
